summary: Backend-only test of Cargo One Phase 2.3 Beta readiness. Focused on new POST /api/auth/me/delete endpoint and regression coverage for /users/{id}/profile and /jobs/{job_id}/bids verified_driver enrichment. Wrote 8 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_account_delete.py — ALL 8 PASS. Soft-delete anonymises the user (email prefixed 'deleted+...@cargoone.internal', name='Deleted user', phone/profile_photo cleared, status='suspended', deleted_at set), purges the user's documents and notifications, and blocks subsequent login. Auth guard returns 401 for missing/invalid tokens. Regressions confirmed: public profile returns reviews[], completed_bookings, verified_driver; bids list is enriched with verified_driver + total_jobs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1557 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, users, jobs, bids, admin, documents, reviews) per code_review_guidelines (>700 lines).

POST /api/auth/me/delete does not invalidate the JWT server-side (token continues to decode until expiry). Because login is blocked and the user is anonymised this is low-risk, but for full compliance consider a token/version blacklist or bumping a token_version claim so already-issued tokens are rejected.

delete_me() does not touch bookings/jobs/bids/reviews authored by the user; only documents and notifications are purged. This appears intentional (booking records retained), but confirm GDPR posture with product — driver_name / customer_name snapshots stored on jobs, bids, bookings, and reviews still contain the original name after account deletion.
seed_data_creation: Tests register fresh TEST_ prefixed customer & driver accounts per-test via /api/auth/register. Admin login uses seeded admin@cargoone.com. Created accounts are left in DB as suspended/anonymised — no cleanup required, they are already anonymised by the delete flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_account_delete.py -v`. BASE_URL is taken from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Endpoint under test: POST /api/auth/me/delete. Regressions validated: GET /api/users/{id}/profile and GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/bids. Job payload requires JobCreate schema (category, collection_date, delivery_date, vehicle_required — NOT pickup_date/vehicle_type). Documents list endpoint is /api/users/me/documents and returns {required, documents}, not a flat list.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found. All acceptance criteria for the new endpoint met.
